name: Currencyprofits_01.1
summary: Currencyprofits_01.1 is a trend-following EA that trades based on moving average crossover signals and momentum confirmation. It opens positions in the direction of the prevailing trend and uses trailing stops to protect profits. The EA is designed for major currency pairs and operates on medium timeframes.
summary_zh: Currencyprofits_01.1是一个趋势跟踪型EA，基于均线交叉信号和动量确认进行交易。它顺着当前趋势方向开仓，并使用追踪止损来保护利润。该EA专为主流货币对设计，适用于中周期图表。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是基于均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统，当快速均线穿越慢速均线时产生入场信号。入场条件需要动量指标（如RSI或MACD）确认趋势方向，避免在震荡行情中频繁开仓。出场条件包括固定的止盈止损以及追踪止损机制，随着价格沿有利方向移动而动态调整止损位。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于账户余额的比例仓位方法，但缺乏动态调整波动率的机制。资金管理方面，该EA没有明确的账户风险百分比控制，可能导致在连续亏损时风险敞口过大。整体策略逻辑较为基础，依赖趋势行情获利，在震荡市中容易出现反复止损。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is a trend-following system based on moving average crossovers, generating entry signals when the fast MA crosses the slow MA. Entry conditions require momentum indicator confirmation (such as RSI or MACD) to validate the trend direction, avoiding frequent entries during ranging markets. Exit conditions include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels as well as a trailing stop mechanism that dynamically adjusts the stop level as price moves favorably. Position sizing uses fixed lot sizes or account-balance proportional methods, but lacks dynamic volatility-adjusted position sizing. In terms of money management, the EA does not implement explicit account risk percentage controls, which may lead to excessive risk exposure during consecutive losing streaks. The overall strategy logic is relatively basic, relying on trending markets for profitability and prone to repeated stop-outs during choppy conditions.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, locks profit target per trade

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: Magic number for closing, 0 for all positions

pros: 趋势跟踪逻辑清晰，在明确趋势行情中表现良好
使用追踪止损能有效锁定浮动利润
参数化设计便于优化和调整策略
pros_en: Clear trend-following logic that performs well in strong trending markets
Trailing stop effectively locks in floating profits
Parameterized design allows easy optimization and strategy tuning
cons: 震荡行情中容易频繁止损，缺乏过滤机制
仓位管理较为粗糙，未考虑波动率动态调整
缺少新K线检查，可能在同一根K线重复开仓
cons_en: Prone to frequent stop-outs in ranging markets due to lack of filtering mechanism
Position sizing is crude without dynamic volatility adjustment
Lacks new bar check which may cause duplicate entries on the same candle
improvements: 增加ATR或布林带等波动率指标作为行情过滤器，减少震荡市中的无效交易
实现基于账户风险百分比的动态仓位管理，替代固定手数
improvements_en: Add volatility-based filters such as ATR or Bollinger Bands to reduce ineffective trades in ranging markets
Implement dynamic position sizing based on account risk percentage instead of fixed lot sizes

risk_points: 缺少新K线检查可能导致同根K线重复开仓
固定手数仓位管理在波动剧烈时风险不可控
risk_points_en: Lack of new bar check may cause duplicate entries on the same candle
Fixed lot position sizing makes risk uncontrollable during high volatility
